insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Taliyah is always on their mind
insights.text: They pick or ban Taliyah in 44/108 games (41%): 7 picks (6-1) and 37 bans.

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: No Xin Zhao? They go Nocturne
insights.text: Xin Zhao is a G1 favorite (14/40 G1s, played by Oner). In the 44 later games where it was burned or banned, Oner went to Nocturne (6/44) and Wukong (5/44).

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: In G3+ they go about as deep as the league
insights.text: In 28 G3+ games, 47/140 picks (34%) were champions they never played in any G1 (league 31%). Pool: 58 champs in G1s, 73 in G3+.
